title: Lengthening a walk by even steps
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph of positive degree, let $u,v$ be vertices, and let $w$ be a finite sequence of neighbor indices whose walk from $u$ ends at $v$. For every natural number $m$, there is another sequence of neighbor indices whose walk from $u$ also ends at $v$ and whose length is the length of $w$ plus $2m$.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a regular multigraph of degree $D>0$
The walk specified by $w$ from $u$ ends at $v$
